script_text: Aquarius, a cosmic curveball is about to rewrite your love script this week! As the Sun transits your 6th House of work, a tense square from Saturn in your 2nd House on Monday pressures finances, making Tuesday worst for money talks. But Wednesday, Venus in your 7th House sextiles Uranus, your Air ruler, in your 5th House, igniting sudden romantic sparks. The key shift arrives Thursday when Mercury enters your 7th House, turning communication with partners from stagnant to electric. Mars in your 8th House trines Pluto in your 1st House this weekend, fueling career ambition through shared resources, while Sunday’s gentle Moon in your 3rd House brings networking. Wednesday is your power day because Venus sextiles Uranus in your 5th House. Monday is your worst day because Saturn squares your 2nd House finances. Negotiate contracts midweek when Venus boosts charm. Follow for daily updates.
